newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint gets new credit commitment.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint gets new credit commitment.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Thursday it obtained a commitment for a $200 million global credit facility to replace facilities that provide for $125 million of available capital.

The new five-year facility will enable Brightpoint to borrow in multiple currencies and will be used for the company's working capital needs on a global basis, as well as for certain capital expenditures and potential acquisitions.
Brightpoint said the credit facility is with Banc One Corp's Banc One, Indiana NA and First Chicago NBD Corp's First National Bank of Chicago.
Brightpoint distributes wireless communications equipment and products, and produces related services.
